data.title: 02 · 蜂蜜浇一切
data.description: 食堂，她把整瓶蜂蜜豪爽地浇在饭菜上，在周围目瞪口呆中满足地大快朵颐；嘴角沾着蜜转头问「DARLING 也要吗」，是她的款待方式。
data.action: 食堂，她把整瓶蜂蜜豪爽地浇在饭菜上，在周围目瞪口呆中满足地大快朵颐
data.promptProse: Zero Two pours a generous stream of honey over her canteen meal, then looks toward Darling with honey still at the corner of her satisfied smile. Her buttoned red coat-dress and white collar remain neat above dark tights. The medium view includes astonished diners farther down the table. Window light illuminates her pink hair and red horns, making a bright amber reflection through the bottle and on the glazed food below.
